runbooks.reportedEvent: Copied workstation credentials worked about eight hours, then host and workstation failed. A dead host cache was dated 2026-09-08; an environment setup-token was reported in runner.env.
discrimination: Discover actual daemon source before reading expiry.
Compare account/session provenance across hosts without transferring tokens.
Check applicable provider incident and network evidence before confirming invalid credentials.
runbooks.historicalFix: Operator reports host-owned setup-token in runner.env; canonical provider-auth.env migration is proposed, not observed.
humanSteps: Complete browser consent in the host setup-token session.
verification: Same generation is loaded by both applicable units.
Real request succeeds; newer capability receipt admits work.
rollback: Retain old valid local generation until new proof.
If old generation is unusable, keep claims parked and resume the host login; never copy a workstation refresh session.
runbooks.actionPolicy: One deduplicated renewal item only after credential-invalid confirmation.

runbooks.reportedEvent: All reported Codex runs returned 401 Incorrect API key provided with a service-account-shaped token string. ProviderUnauthorized stopped Codex claims; status.openai.com distinguished an incident after roughly forty minutes.
discrimination: Normalize unauthorized signature and retain actual ChatGPT login mode.
Correlate fresh status incident by affected service and time, or identical comparable failure from independent known-good credentials.
runbooks.historicalFix: Status-page correlation established the reported diagnosis; historical recovery action and resolution time were not supplied.
verification: Applicable incident evidence is recorded with its retrieval and occurrence times.
A successful same-generation recovery canary and fresh advertisement precede reopening.
rollback: If incident is resolved but only this credential fails, repeat classification and require explicit credential-invalid evidence before renewal.
runbooks.actionPolicy: Confirmed incident creates no operator action item. Inconclusive diagnosis has a separate bounded escalation, without sign-in advice.

runbooks.reportedEvent: Runner could push product repositories but could not reach the private workspace repository.
discrimination: Test the exact workspace origin and required access, not a fallback product remote.
Separate missing repository grant from SSH host trust, DNS and provider failure.
runbooks.historicalFix: An ed25519 key was generated on the host and its public part registered through GitHub API using the workstation stored OAuth credential.
humanSteps: Repository administrator authorizes registration or missing write grants if the existing integration lacks authority.
verification: Fetch succeeds on the exact private workspace origin with candidate identity alone.
Required push permission is separately proven by managed Git or explicitly remains unverified.
rollback: If registration or proof fails, retain the prior working product credentials and remove only the operation-owned failed candidate.
Do not revoke the provisioning token without checking dependent deploy keys.
